Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner enters a persistent loop at step 3 by incorrectly assuming a ruler born in AD 43 exists and failing to recognize that the search results (showing Cunobelinus born ~10 AD) contradict the premise. This data misinterpretation and refusal to pivot the strategy make the reasoning path irrecoverable, as subsequent steps only repeat the same futile search for an AD 43 birth year.
